cards.name: NVIDIA (Maxwell/Pascal) — reference only
cards.notes: Most Maxwell/Pascal cards have no Mac EFI GOP vBIOS; use OpenCore/OCLP for a boot screen instead of a vBIOS flash. Kepler Mac EFI ROMs exist but are card-specific.
